recommendedNewSections.heading: Key Features to Look for in an AI Website Builder
recommendedNewSections.reason: To provide a comprehensive framework for users to evaluate builders beyond just a list, addressing common comparison criteria and helping them make an informed decision.
recommendedNewSections.suggestedOutline: Discuss essential aspects like AI capabilities (content, design), customization flexibility, ease of use, third-party integrations, built-in SEO features, scalability for growth, and available customer support.

recommendedNewSections.heading: AI Website Builders for Specific Use Cases
recommendedNewSections.reason: Users often have specific needs (e-commerce, portfolio, blog, small business). This section helps them quickly identify the best AI builder tailored to their particular project.
recommendedNewSections.suggestedOutline: Create subsections for 'E-commerce Websites', 'Portfolios & Freelancers', 'Small Businesses & Startups', and 'Blogs & Personal Sites', highlighting suitable builders for each.

recommendedNewSections.heading: The Future of AI in Website Design
recommendedNewSections.reason: To offer a forward-looking perspective, demonstrating expertise and capturing interest in emerging trends and what users can expect from AI website builders in the coming years.
recommendedNewSections.suggestedOutline: Discuss anticipated advancements in AI, hyper-personalized user experiences, integration with voice search, dynamic content generation, and ethical considerations.

recommendedNewSections.heading: Ensuring Security and Data Privacy with AI Website Builders
recommendedNewSections.reason: Addresses a critical concern for users, especially with AI tools handling sensitive information and personal data. This builds trust and provides essential guidance.
recommendedNewSections.suggestedOutline: Discuss how AI builders handle user data, GDPR and other compliance standards, built-in security features (SSL, backups), and best practices for users to protect their site and visitors.
